prose.intro:
The computation used to train each notable AI model, as a scatter by publication date, with the data from OWID's "Notable AI models" multidim. Reach for it in articles about the growth of AI training, where a narrower time range, fixed axis ends or the uncertainty of the estimates help make a point.

```archie
{.bespoke-component}
  bundle: ai-training-compute
  variant: scatter
  size: wide
{}
```

```archie
{.bespoke-component}
  bundle: ai-training-compute
  variant: scatter
  size: wide
  {.config}
    title: Training computation of AI models since 2010
    startYear: 2010
    yAxisMin: 1e15
    colorBy: developer
    hideColorBy: true
  {}
{}
```

```archie
{.bespoke-component}
  bundle: ai-training-compute
  variant: scatter
  size: wide
  {.config}
    startYear: 2018
    yScale: linear
    hideYScaleToggle: true
    showUncertainty: true
  {}
{}
```
prose.notes:
The y-axis ends take a number of FLOP in any common notation: `1e24`, `10^24`, `10²⁴` or `3 × 10^24`. Note that `10e24` means 10 × 10²⁴, which is 10²⁵.

Without an authored subtitle, the chart uses the multidim's subtitle for the current color, which explains what the colors show, so it changes when a reader switches the color.

The uncertainty ranges come from Epoch AI's confidence in each estimate (within 3×, 10× or 31× either way, as 90% intervals). The OWID data doesn't carry the confidence label yet, so the bundle looks it up by model name in a file generated from Epoch AI's data; a model new to the OWID data shows no range until that file is regenerated.

variants.name: scatter
variants.description: The computation used to train each notable AI model, by publication date, colored by developer or by whether the figure was reported or estimated

config.name: title
config.description: Chart title
config.default: Computation used to train notable AI models

config.name: subtitle
config.description: Chart subtitle. Defaults to the multidim's subtitle for the current color, which explains what the colors show

config.name: note
config.description: Note in the chart's footer
config.default: One floating-point operation (FLOP) is a single calculation, such as adding or multiplying two decimal numbers. Where developers do not report it, Epoch AI estimates training compute from a model’s size, training data, hardware, or cost; the least-documented estimates may be off by a factor of about 30. About half of notable models have no compute figure and are not shown.

config.name: startYear
config.description: First year on the time axis. Defaults to the year of the earliest model

config.name: endYear
config.description: Last year on the time axis, included in full. Defaults to the year of the latest model

config.name: yAxisMin
config.format: A number of FLOP, such as `1e24`, `10^24` or `10²⁴`
config.description: Bottom of the y axis. Defaults to fit the models in view, from 0 on a linear axis

config.name: yAxisMax
config.format: A number of FLOP, such as `1e27`, `10^27` or `10²⁷`
config.description: Top of the y axis. Defaults to fit the models in view

config.name: yScale
config.description: Whether the y axis starts logarithmic or linear

config.name: hideYScaleToggle
config.description: Hide the switch between a logarithmic and linear y axis

config.name: colorBy
config.description: What the dot colors show at first: whether the figure was reported by the developer or estimated by Epoch AI, or the developer

config.name: hideColorBy
config.description: Hide the “Color by” dropdown

config.name: showUncertainty
config.description: Draw each estimate's 90% uncertainty range, from Epoch AI's confidence in it

config.name: labeledModels
config.description: Comma-separated model names (as in the data) to label on the chart, most important first
config.default: GPT-6 Astra, AlexNet, GPT-3 175B (davinci), AlphaGo Lee, Theseus, Perceptron Mark I, TD-Gammon, AlphaFold 2, GPT-4 (Mar 2023), NetTalk (transcription), Neocognitron, ADALINE, GraphCast

config.name: title
config.description: Chart title, replacing the generated one

config.name: subtitle
config.description: Chart subtitle, replacing the generated one

config.name: region
config.description: Country shown first, or United States if the data doesn't have it. `userLocation` picks the user's country

config.name: time
config.description: Year shown first. `populationPyramid` only

config.name: fertilityRateAssumptions
config.format: Up to three comma-separated numbers for 2030, 2050 and 2100, such as `1.8,,1.5`. An empty entry keeps the UN projection
config.description: Fertility rate assumptions, in births per woman

config.name: lifeExpectancyAssumptions
config.format: Up to three comma-separated numbers for 2030, 2050 and 2100, such as `80,,85`. An empty entry keeps the UN projection
config.description: Life expectancy assumptions, in years

config.name: netMigrationRateAssumptions
config.format: Up to three comma-separated numbers for 2030, 2050 and 2100, such as `2,,1`. An empty entry keeps the UN projection
config.description: Net migration rate assumptions, per 1,000 people. The chart shows them as a percentage

config.name: focusParameter
config.description: Assumption shown first in the editor. `simulation` only

config.name: populationPyramidUnit

config.name: hideEntitySelector

config.name: hidePopulationPyramid

config.name: hideTimeline
config.description: Hide the year slider and fit the axis to the year shown. `populationPyramid` only

config.name: showAssumptionCharts
